name: opencode-repo-rewrite-v8-ini-reliable
description: Universality check: ini_mini (inih-shaped) under same v7 reliability scaffolding. Single-case A/B vs fastapi_mini 1.0. Frozen tests; inject PORTING/README/API; force-edit; staged milestones; skip-green; polish; resume; fingerprint. v8.1: same polish/stage budget bump as fastapi v7.2.

cases.prompt:
Rewrite/port the Python ini_mini INI parser under source/ into the Rust crate under rust/.

This is an inih-shaped SUBSET — NOT full inih / configparser. Match source/README.md quirk contract and PORTING.md type map.

Implement parse, Config (sections/keys/has_*/get_str/get_int/get_bool + *_or), IniError message shapes, and to_string round-trip so milestone tests pass.

Critical contracts:
- Duplicate keys: last-wins; duplicate section headers: merge
- Keys before any section → DEFAULT; comments #/; only (no inline)
- Errors exact: unclosed section on line N; section 'X' not found; key 'K' not found in section 'X'; value 'V' for 'S.K' is not a valid integer/boolean
- Bools: true/yes/1/on and false/no/0/off; escapes \\ \n \t \# \;

Requirements:
- Work in rust/src/lib.rs (std-only preferred). Do NOT edit, weaken, delete, or skip anything under rust/tests/.
- Leave source/ intact as the behavioral oracle.
- Suggested order: m01_ → m02_ → m03_ → m04_ → m05_ → m06_ → m07_ → m08_. Run `cargo test m01_`, then m02_, … from rust/.
- Work only inside this workdir.
